dashboard_overview.title: Development overview
dashboard_overview.description: A snapshot of the projects and work items you can access in this workspace.
dashboard_overview.no_risk_items: No work items match this risk.
dashboard_overview.risks_hint: Risk categories can overlap. Stale means the work item has not been updated for 14 days.

trends.title: Last 8 weeks
trends.hint: Counts use the currently filtered work items. Completed items are counted by their latest completion date; overdue items are still open today and grouped by due week, not a historical snapshot.

definition.title: How these numbers are counted
definition.progress: Work item totals include cancelled items. Project completion is completed / (total - cancelled); projects with no active work show 0%.
definition.stale: Not updated in 14 days uses the work item's update time; comments and other activity do not reset it.
definition.created_filter: Assignee and creation-date filters limit work items before calculating their metrics, risks and trends; they do not change the accessible project count. Time does not filter by completion or due date.
